scope: Selected advisories only; version matches do not prove exploitability or absence of other vulnerabilities.

packages.name: @anthropic-ai/claude-code
packages.fix: 2.1.179 or later for this advisory; prefer the latest supported release through your existing installer.
packages.conditions: Installing a plugin from an attacker-controlled upstream on a host permitting SHA-shaped branch names.

packages.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
packages.fix: 1.31.0 or later; also follow the issuer/expectedIssuer credential migration in docs/ADVISORIES.md.
packages.conditions: HTTP OAuth client holding credentials connects to an untrusted MCP server; stdio clients and SDK servers are excluded from this advisory.

packages.name: @modelcontextprotocol/client
packages.fix: 2.2.0 or later; directly imported core also needs 2.2.0 or later. Migrate stored credentials and bundled providers.
packages.conditions: HTTP OAuth use with the provider/storage/direct-fetchToken configurations listed in the advisory.

packages.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
packages.conditions: Experimental task support: evaluate the session isolation conditions in the advisory.

packages.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
packages.conditions: Server bearer authentication; inspect token audience validation and deployment configuration.

packages.name: @modelcontextprotocol/server
packages.fix: 2.3.0 or later AND one server/transport per request or session, or a createMcpHandler factory.
packages.conditions: Multiple HTTP clients share a server or stateless transport instance; stdio is excluded.

packages.name: n8n
packages.fix: 2.43.5+ on the 2.43 branch, or 2.44.1+ on the 2.44 branch. Follow the supported upgrade path and back up persistent data.
packages.conditions: A member able to create/run workflows can access Data Table rows across projects. The advisory body does not establish a 1.x fix.
